grapefruit.name: Grapefruit
grapefruit.tagline: Tart, sparkling and invigorating with every sip.
grapefruit.description: Crisp organic pink grapefruit paired with shade-grown South American yerba mate. Delivers a clean, sustained lift without the afternoon slump.
grapefruit.quote: The grapefruit punch is unbeatable for early morning deep work sessions.
grapefruit.author: Mathieu L., Montreal

hibiscus.name: Blackberry & Hibiscus
hibiscus.tagline: Deep berry richness balanced with delicate floral botanicals.
hibiscus.description: Wild Canadian blackberries steeped with tart organic hibiscus flowers. A sophisticated, vibrant berry infusion that awakens the palate.
hibiscus.quote: Tastes like an artisanal natural soda, but powers my whole afternoon.
hibiscus.author: Chloe D., Quebec City

tropical.name: Tropical Punch
tropical.tagline: A sunny vacation in a can — passion fruit, mango & pineapple.
tropical.description: Lush tropical fruit juices blended with energizing yerba mate. Naturally golden, intensely refreshing, and bursting with vibrant sunshine.
tropical.quote: The tropical punch is literally summer in a can. Instant mood booster.
tropical.author: Alexandre G., Toronto

melon.name: Melon & Mint
melon.tagline: Sweet honeydew nectar kissed with icy, cool garden mint.
melon.description: Crisp green honeydew melon combined with brisk garden mint leaves. Exceptionally refreshing, restorative, and revitalizing on hot days.
melon.quote: Super crisp and not too sweet. The mint finish is pure genius.
melon.author: Sophie V., Montreal

footer.join_desc: Be the first to know about seasonal flavor drops, secret sample kits, and pop-up events in Montreal.
footer.faq1_a: Yerba Maté is a traditional South American botanical powerhouse brewed from the leaves of the Ilex paraguariensis plant. Renowned for providing natural caffeine alongside theobromine and polyphenols, delivering clean energy without caffeine jitters or crashes.
footer.faq2_q: How much caffeine is in each can?
footer.faq2_a: Each 355ml can contains 120mg of naturally occurring plant caffeine — equivalent to approximately 1.5 shots of espresso or a strong cup of brewed coffee.
footer.faq3_q: Where is MANA brewed and produced?
footer.faq3_a: MANA is proudly developed, formulated, and brewed in Quebec, Canada, using certified organic organic ingredients and pure water.
footer.faq4_a: We offer fast, tracked shipping with FREE shipping on all orders over $35 CAD across Quebec and Ontario.
